description: This file defines the FractionFormatter class, which formats numerical values as fractions according to specified formats within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: FractionFormatter
classes.description: A formatter class that converts numbers into fractional string representations based on provided formats.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a given numeric value into a fractional string according to the specified format pattern.

methods.name: getDecimal
methods.description: Extracts the decimal portion of a number as a string.
